title: Say Soberano ya Kinmerew na Inka-Dios
intro: Sakey a makapanyari tan mapaatagey a manuley so manisia ya anggapoy makatalindeg ed trono ra. Inusilan da so ombabatik a grupo diad malaknab a danum, balet diad makapabiglan anggaan. Say istorya na sayan soberano et narerengel ed dakel a bersikulo na Quran, ya manseserbin pasakbay ed amin.
clues: Sakey ak a makapanyarin manuley ya manisia ya anggapoy autoridad ya onlampas ed siak diad saray bansan uuleyan ko.
Walay sakey a napanmatalkan kon vizier a manngaran na Haman ya tinmulong ed siak a manggawa na angkakabaleg iran proyekto ed arkitektura.
Impatawag ko ray sankamaongan a managsalamangka ed bansak pian labanan da ray tanda na sakey a mensahero ya onsusumpad siak.
Agko inabuloyan ya ontaynan iray totoon naaripen ed loob na nanarian ko, anggaman ed saray salot tan malinew iran pasakbay.
Inosilan ko rad maawang a dayat a kaibak so intiron sondalok tan saray karwahi.
Saman a mismon dayat so nansara ed siak tan saray puersa ko, ya amalereg ed sikami ya amin, legan iran maligen a binmaliw.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Saray salot tan pidedeneng ed si Musa (Moses)
Manggagawa na biong sakbay na baleg a delap
Idepensa iray matuan belat na panaglakoan
trial.answer: Saray salot tan pidedeneng ed si Musa (Moses)

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a baleg a biong a gawad kiew
Sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nalner ed dayat kaiba so armada
Nilaban lapud panangasi tan anos nen Allah et nagunggonaan
Akapiulop lamet ed pamilya kayari na dakel a taon ya kairapan
outcome.answer: Nalner ed dayat kaiba so armada

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
